name: ProjectMind for Google Antigravity
description: Universal local-first project intelligence, persistent context engine, and autonomous lifecycle hooks for Google Antigravity.

capabilities.restartInstructions: Run `/mcp` or `/skills reload` in Antigravity CLI/IDE, or start a new conversation.
documentedLimitations: Unconfigured MCP tools run in Ask mode by default unless allowed via policy (`mcp(projectmind/*)`).

installationInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin install antigravity` in your project root.
upgradeInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin update antigravity` to refresh configs, skills, and hooks.
removalInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin uninstall antigravity` to cleanly remove integration while preserving project knowledge.
